name: Shukumi Yuise
source:
The eldest of three sisters, she primarily handles the shrine's back office and oversees accounting. Despite a low alcohol tolerance, she enjoys drinking and isn't particularly skilled at social interactions.

「Check out these offerings! We're already raking in gazillions in donations!」
